obvious_hallucination.content: 1. For all tasks, we observe that the invariance point (where the invariance score exceeds 90% of its maximum value) is consistently reached very early in training, at step 100.
obvious_hallucination.reason: Clear code bug in run_4.py (line 492-495): the max_invariance_score is updated to inv_score immediately before the threshold check. At step 100 (first measurement), S > 0.9 * S is always true for any S > 0. So invariance_point is always set to 100 regardless of actual dynamics. For x_minus_y and x_plus_y, the invariance score at step 100 is only 0.017-0.037, far below 90% of the eventual maximum (~1.0). The invariance_point=100 result is an artifact of the ordering bug, not a scientific finding about early invariance learning.
code_evidence: run_4.py:492-495 (inv_score > max_invariance_score update before threshold check)
run_4/final_info.json: x_minus_y seed 0 invariance score at step 100 = 0.017, eventual max = 1.0
